title: Rental Day, Return, Fuel and Mileage Terms of Rental Vehicle Coordination
content:
Under Rental Vehicle Coordination, one rental day lasts 24 hours from the pickup time for every rental class, and the rental partner's return, fuel and mileage terms are the same across the six classes.

## Terms by class

| Rental class | Length of one rental day (hours) | Return grace (minutes) | Key-drop return outside branch hours counted at next opening | Branch opening time (local) | Fuel policy | Refuel charge (USD per gallon) | Unlimited mileage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Rental | 24 | 29 | Yes | 07:30 | Full to full | 6.49 | Yes |
| Compact Rental | 24 | 29 | Yes | 07:30 | Full to full | 6.49 | Yes |
| Intermediate Rental | 24 | 29 | Yes | 07:30 | Full to full | 6.49 | Yes |
| Full-Size Rental | 24 | 29 | Yes | 07:30 | Full to full | 6.49 | Yes |
| Standard SUV Rental | 24 | 29 | Yes | 07:30 | Full to full | 6.49 | Yes |
| Minivan Rental | 24 | 29 | Yes | 07:30 | Full to full | 6.49 | Yes |

## Meaning of each term

- **Length of one rental day**: the length of one rental day, counted from the pickup time, in hours.
- **Return grace**: the minutes past the end of a rental day within which a return does not start a further rental day (a whole number of minutes).
- **Key-drop return counted at next opening**: whether a key-drop return outside branch hours is counted as returned at the branch's next opening time.
- **Branch opening time**: the partner branch opening time used for after-hours returns, in local time.
- **Fuel policy**: full to full, meaning the rental is returned with the fuel level it left with.
- **Refuel charge**: the charge per gallon to refill a rental returned short of fuel.
- **Unlimited mileage**: whether mileage is unlimited.

## Points of reference

- A key-drop return made outside branch hours is, for every class, counted as made at 07:30 local time, the partner branch's opening time.
- Hypothetical figure: a Minivan Rental returned four gallons short of the fuel level it left with is short of fuel under the full-to-full policy, and the refuel charge for those four gallons is four times 6.49 USD, that is 25.96 USD.
